fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL) recorded Q4 revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12% year-over-year, but elevated valuation has resulted in mixed analyst assessments and the stock has not received a 'buy' rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: iPhone revenue increased 17% year-over-year to $57.6 billion, and Mac revenue rose 24% to $10.8 billion, reflecting strong demand in emerging markets.
fields.summary_ko.2: AAPL has risen more than 28% this year, significantly outpacing the Magnificent Seven, but even with a cautious AI investment strategy, the elevated valuation is difficult to justify.
